ingameEffects.label: Ten Top Ten (W-Engine Pasive)
ingameEffects.description: Reduces DMG taken by a percentage. After being attacked, the next attack to hit an enemy will trigger a critical hit and deal additional DMG based on the equipper’s DEF. This effect can be triggered once every 7.5s.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: This w-engine does not affect the equipper's stats.
